title: Big Pharma, with eye on Anthropic, says AI is shrinking drug discovery timelines

sentences.t: Big Pharma, with eye on Anthropic, says AI is shrinking drug discovery timelines

Artificial intelligence has sped up early-stage drug development at some of the world's largest pharmaceutical companies, cutting by as much as half the time it takes to produce new molecules and move them into the clinic, according to their top scientists.

GSK, Bristol Myers Squibb, Novartis, Eli Lilly, Novo Nordisk, AstraZeneca and Sanofi say they now use AI for designing molecules, sorting the most promising ones, and identifying safety risks; Sanofi said AI saved at least a year on its asthma treatment lunsekimig, and Novo Nordisk cut molecule design cycles from around eight to three.

Anthropic is gearing up to be a rival, partner or both to the drugmakers, with its own laboratory and its Claude Science software; Lilly's Aliza Apple said claims that the technology can cure all disease overstate current capabilities.

title: A cyberattack using artificial intelligence targeted the EU in October, official says

sentences.t: A cyberattack using artificial intelligence targeted the EU in October, official says

Cybersecurity experts have been dealing with an AI-generated attack on a key European Union institution for almost a month, an official confirmed on Thursday, with some of the bloc's digital tools still offline.
It was the first time the 27-member bloc reported a cyberattack using an AI tool; the EU first detected the incident on Oct.
22 and launched an investigation while imposing preventive measures, and no evidence of a data breach affecting commission staff as a whole was detected.
The EU agency CERT-EU had posted a Nov.
4 warning about a tool called ARTEX, designed to use AI to identify vulnerabilities, which has been linked to recent attacks across the globe.
The headline link goes to a summary of the Associated Press story.

title: Should AI be judging our credit worthiness?

sentences.t: Should AI be judging our credit worthiness?

With more financial data available than ever, AI-powered lending firms such as Upstart and Zest AI offer lenders another way to assess credit worthiness; Upstart says its machine-learning models look at more than 2,500 variables.

Mortgage expert Sarah Tucker said AI could help lenders build a more individual picture of affordability and risk, with a real opportunity to improve financial inclusion for so-called thin-file applicants.

Oxford professor Sandra Wachter warned that AI does not know about existing social inequalities and could replicate past decisions, and that firms must apply regulations and guardrails so AI does not perpetuate the biases of the past.
The headline link goes to a summary of the BBC News story.

title: Wall St futures slip as Anthropic debut fails to reassure AI investors

sentences.t: Wall St futures slip as Anthropic debut fails to reassure AI investors
US stock futures fell on Friday as Anthropic shares retreated after a blockbuster debut, dashing hopes the listing could steady an AI trade rattled by growth and valuation concerns.

Anthropic shares slid 6.8% in premarket trading after surging more than 17% on Thursday; the Nasdaq was 13.6% below its record closing high of October 6, and chipmakers Nvidia, AMD, Broadcom, Marvell and Micron lost between 2.6% and 5.5%.

Wall Street's main indexes were on track for their steepest weekly decline since April 2025, even though 83.5% of the 462 S&P 500 companies to have reported results through Wednesday beat analyst expectations.

title: AI listing fails to halt global market slide

sentences.t: AI listing fails to halt global market slide

Stock markets around the world fell sharply on Friday, as a record-breaking debut for Anthropic failed to calm a deepening sell-off in technology shares, in what is shaping up to be one of the worst weeks for equities in years.

Asian markets were on course for their worst week since 2020: Taiwan's main index dropped 6.7 percent, Japan's Nikkei lost 5 percent, and SoftBank suffered its worst day in more than two years, falling 14.5 percent in Tokyo.

Analyst Daniela Hathorn said the listing showed demand for AI exposure was still strong, but not enough to overcome concerns about high valuations, profitability and whether the current pace of investment can be sustained.
The headline link goes to a summary of The Guardian story.

title: Anthropic's historic IPO fails to revive the AI trade

sentences.t: Anthropic's historic IPO fails to revive the AI trade
Anthropic's historic IPO — the largest in U.S. history — delivered a big win for the company and its investors, but failed to revive animal spirits in the AI trade, CNBC reported.

The Nasdaq Composite closed down 2.25% amid a broader pullback, with the S&P 500 declining 2% to 7,175; neoclouds such as CoreWeave closed down more than 6%, and hyperscalers Alphabet and Amazon also finished lower.

Investor Dan Niles told CNBC a price war between Anthropic and OpenAI has hurt both companies: their combined revenue growth slowed from 75% sequentially in Q2 to 48% in Q3, while combined losses rose from $7.9 billion to about $8.4 billion.
The headline link goes to a summary of the CNBC story.

title: Why Canada is embracing AI data centres while the US pushes back

sentences.t: Why Canada is embracing AI data centres while the US pushes back

As Americans have grown increasingly sour on AI data centre development, Canada's industry leaders are sensing an opportunity, after US voters passed 40 of 41 local ballot initiatives aimed at limiting data centre development in this month's midterm elections.

At the heart of Canada's boom is Alberta, where 90% of all currently proposed sites are set to be built; Kevin O'Leary's 7,000-acre, 7.5-gigawatt Wonder Valley project there has strong provincial and municipal backing, while his Utah project faces fierce local opposition.
Canada's federal government has framed AI data centres as a matter of national security and sovereignty and projects the country needs to expand computing capacity 16-fold over the next four years.

title: California targets Nvidia in China AI chip probe

sentences.t: California targets Nvidia in China AI chip probe
California has served an investigative subpoena on the AI chip designer Nvidia in the wake of a scandal that ended in the departure of longtime CEO Jensen Huang.

Attorney General Rob Bonta said he is probing whether Nvidia or Huang's actions resulted in China obtaining advanced chips or confidential information, adding that such actions could violate California law if the company misled investors and the public.

Nvidia, which has its global headquarters in Santa Clara, California, has seen its shares plummet 22% since the affair was reported in early November; some members of Congress have urged the Commerce Department to investigate whether customer Megaspeed diverted Nvidia chips to China.

title: California Probing If Nvidia Misled Investors on China Risks

sentences.t: California Probing If Nvidia Misled Investors on China Risks
Nvidia Corp. is being investigated by California officials to determine whether any of its actions resulted in advanced chips or confidential information being improperly obtained by China.
Attorney General Rob Bonta said in a statement Thursday that his office is also looking into whether the company misled investors about the situation.
Nvidia was sent a subpoena seeking information to determine if the company violated the state's corporate security law, Bonta said.

title: The connection between high-fat ketogenic diets and weight loss

sentences.t: The connection between high-fat ketogenic diets and weight loss

New findings reported in Cell Metabolism suggest dietary composition and genetic differences may be overlooked influences on metabolic responses to ketogenic diets in mice; in genetically susceptible mice, a very-low-protein version triggered liver stress and inflammatory responses that suppressed appetite.

Mice fed a ketogenic diet with just 5% protein reduced food intake by about 40% after four weeks and lost weight, while mice on a similar diet with 10% protein ate more and gained weight, even though both groups produced ketones.

The team identified two genes, NNT and NLRP12; because the study was done in mice, the findings cannot be directly applied to humans, first author Zhaoyue Zhang said, and the low-protein mice also developed fatty liver and lost lean mass.

title: UK launches latest renewables auction in drive to decarbonise

sentences.t: UK launches latest renewables auction in drive to decarbonise

The British government on Thursday announced its latest auction for renewable power, seeking bids from clean energy project developers as part of its drive to decarbonise the electricity sector by 2030 and help lower consumer bills.

Seeking to procure new wind and solar developments, Britain holds regular auctions to set the budget of projects; the government said it would set a final budget once all bids have been submitted, a change from setting it beforehand.
Over the last two years, auctions have secured enough clean electricity to power more than 20 million homes, the government said.

title: Can larger batteries safely power residential buildings? A project in New York aims to show how

sentences.t: Can larger batteries safely power residential buildings? A project in New York aims to show how
A battery system installed in a Buffalo, New York, apartment building will store excess energy when it is plentiful and power the building when the grid is strained and electricity is costly.

The 3.75 megawatt-hour lithium-ion system, which can power the Peace Bridge Place affordable housing complex for several days, is among the largest battery systems in a U.S. residential building, manufacturer Viridi and developer Good Carbon Co. said.

Deploying large batteries in buildings is an important step toward replacing fossil fuels with renewables, experts say, but such systems are uncommon because of cost and fire-risk concerns; Viridi isolates each cell so a failure dissipates instead of spreading.
